title: Matthew S NDE 8655
content: I have left my body three times in my life: I hit my head on the pavement during a bicycle accident. The first time was at the accident where I witnessed people helping me. I floated above the scene. The second time was in the local doctor's office. We lived thirty miles away in a small town with one country doctor. I was floating above the room in the upper corner. The nurse and doctor where attending. I heard the doctor ask, 'Have the parents have been notified? Has an ambulance was dispatched?' The third time, I was in the ambulance. I was floating in the upper, back corner of the ambulance. The ambulance walls began to burn away. I can best describe it as watching a movie and the film begins to burn away as if the bulb is burning the film. Then, I floated out of the ambulance and above the road. There was a very strong, lighted Presence there. The surrounding sky and landscape began to burn away from the scene and was replaced by a vibrant landscape. The landscape was similar to the location we were passing through, except all of the man-made objects were removed leaving a pristine landscape. All sense of time ceased. I could feel the vibration of the ambulance on the road at first. A lighted Being approached me and ask if I remembered home. I replied that I did, but that I wanted to go back. The Being said that I would be met by my parents at the hospital. He also said that I would face challenges but eventually overcome them and that I would connect with him again later. I woke up after several days, with no memory of the accident. But I did have a vivid memory of my visit and the host. For some time, I had premonitions of bad things that would happen to me and friends. It was difficult to reconcile. I developed a sense of abandonment and threw caution to the wind until my first child was born. I prayed fervently to not have these premonitions and I changed my attitude. Fifty years later, I see God in all things and remember this experience as the second best gift I ever received; my family if first. He said that Love is all there is and to embrace life. I’ve had some heath scares, but I am not afaid to die. I am just afraid to leave my family. Bless you. It’s all God. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: July 1968 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I could feel the ambulance, but it was stationary. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I had a feeling of vast knowledge. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? My third OBE. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No comparison. You could see God in all things. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No recollection of this. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light was alive and brilliant, white light. There was no tunnel. This was like walking through a veil that melted away. It seemed like heaven is right here within arm's length. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Joy Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Uncertain What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain I do not know. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Love is all there is. We are all a part of God. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes God spoke to me and helped with my transition back. He always comes for the children. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Uncertain We have our paths to follow. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I received knowledge that earth is not home but a place we come to advance. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Uncertain During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes This life is a gift. Ask God for help. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes 'Love is all there is.' God. Once we all realize fact, the lesson will be over. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. Religion gives us structure and community. God gave us life. I learned to Honor God and my life. Everyone is God and Everyone is life. Evil only exist in other non-loving humans, not nature. It’s hard to be human. I embrace God and the creation around me. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I am 61 years old. This happened when I was 10 years old. It is my most vivid memory. When life is difficult or great it is the memory that always gets me through or gives me deep appreciation of the gift. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes But I’ve prayed to have them removed and it was answered. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near-death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Uncertain

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Upper, back corner of the ambulance; then floated out of the ambulance and above the road.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt the vibration of the ambulance on the road at first while out of body; described floating above scenes.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "very strong, lighted Presence" and a "lighted Being" who spoke with him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Ambulance walls and then the surrounding sky/landscape "began to burn away" and were replaced by a "vibrant" pristine landscape with man-made objects removed; described as like a veil melting away; "heaven is right here within arm's length."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bicycle accident with head injury; later OBE episodes in doctor's office and ambulance.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Three OBEs (accident scene, doctor's office, ambulance); transition described as walls/scene burning away like film; no tunnel; no life review; no boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Multiple OBEs with the third including transition to a vibrant landscape and encounter/communication with a lighted Being; no tunnel and no boundary.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transition effect described as ambulance walls and then the surrounding scene "began to burn away" like movie film burning; "walking through a veil that melted away."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Have the parents have been notified? Has an ambulance was dispatched?"; "Have you remembered home."; "Love is all there is."; "It seemed like heaven is right here within arm's length."
